essence: Dhūmāvatī is worshipped within the mind-lotus set in motion by drum sound.
Dhūmāvatī is worshipped as identical in form and essence with Tārā.
Dhūmāvatī is worshipped as whose very essence is the letter thakāra.
Dhūmāvatī is revered as the agent of destruction for gods and demons alike.
Dhūmāvatī is worshipped as steadfast and radiant like a stream of smoke.
